# Clean data
## Clean the ferra  data
```{r}
ferra_clinical_clean <- ferra_clinical %>%
  mutate(
    # set OS_event to 1 for patients who died (WD, DOD) and 0 for patients who are alive (NED, LF, AWD)
    OS_event = case_when(
      Status2 %in% c("WD", "DOD") ~ 1,
      Status2 %in% c("NED", "LF", "AWD") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # convert TTDeath from days to months to match other datasets (average month = 30.4375 days)
    OS_time_months = as.numeric(TTDeath) / 30.4375
  )
```

## Clean the Dou survival data

```{r}

dou_survival_clean <- dou_survival %>%
  mutate(
    LRRFS_event = ifelse(`Locoregional recurrence` == "Yes", 1, 0),
    DMFS_event  = ifelse(`Distant metastasis` == "Yes", 1, 0),
    LRRFS_time  = `Locoregional recurrence-free survival (LRRFS)`,
    DMFS_time   = `Distant metastasis-free survival time (DMFS)`
  )

dou_survival_clean[,"Case Number"] = gsub(dou_survival_clean$"Case Number", pattern = "-", replacement = "_")
```


# Functions for survival analysis
```{r}
# Load deconvolution fractions and merge with clinical data.
load_deconv_fractions <- function(deconv_path, clinical_data, sample_col) {
  deconv_matrix <- fread(deconv_path) %>% as.data.frame()
  deconv_fractions <- calculate_deconv_fractions(deconv_matrix)

  if (!"Mixture" %in% names(deconv_fractions)) {
    stop("The deconvolution matrix must contain a 'Mixture' column.")
  }

  names(deconv_fractions)[names(deconv_fractions) == "Mixture"] <- sample_col
  fraction_data <- deconv_fractions %>%
    select(all_of(c(sample_col, deconv_fraction_columns)))

  clinical_data %>%
    inner_join(fraction_data, by = sample_col)
}
```

```{r}
# Extract exactly one named coefficient from a fitted Cox model.
# This prevents main effects or other interaction terms from being plotted by mistake.
extract_cox_term <- function(fit, term_name) {
  coefficient_table <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  if (!term_name %in% rownames(coefficient_table)) {
    stop(
      "Expected Cox coefficient '", term_name,
      "' was not found. Available terms: ",
      paste(rownames(coefficient_table), collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  coefficient_table[term_name, , drop = FALSE]
}

# Run one univariate Cox model for each ligand-receptor pair.
run_lr_survival <- function(
    expression_data,
    clinical_data,
    lr_pairs,
    sample_col,
    time_col,
    event_col,
    survival_type,# i.e "OS" or "DMFS" or "LRRFS"
    data_name,
    log_transform = TRUE,
    cell_fraction_name = NULL
) {
  # Validate the clinical columns before constructing any models.
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(expression_data), is.data.frame(clinical_data))
  if (!sample_col %in% names(clinical_data)) {
    stop("sample_col is not a column in clinical_data")
  }
  if (!all(c(time_col, event_col) %in% names(clinical_data))) {
    stop("time_col and event_col must be columns in clinical_data")
  }
  if (!is.null(cell_fraction_name) &&
      !cell_fraction_name %in% names(clinical_data)) {
    stop("cell_fraction_name is not a column in clinical_data")
  }

  expression_data <- as.data.frame(expression_data)
  if (is.null(rownames(expression_data))) {
    stop("expression_data must have gene names as row names")
  }

  expression_samples <- colnames(expression_data)
  clinical_samples <- as.character(clinical_data[[sample_col]])
  overlapping_samples <- intersect(expression_samples, clinical_samples)
  if (length(overlapping_samples) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No overlapping sample IDs between expression_data columns and clinical_data$",
      sample_col,
      ". Check sample-name formatting."
    )
  }

  # Fit one Cox model for each ligand-receptor pair.
  results <- lapply(lr_pairs, function(pair) {
    ligand <- unname(pair[["ligand"]])
    receptor <- unname(pair[["receptor"]])
    pair_name <- paste(ligand, receptor, sep = " - ")

    if (!all(c(ligand, receptor) %in% rownames(expression_data))) {
      return(data.frame(
        Pair = pair_name, Predictor = pair_name, logHR = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_,
        upper = NA_real_, pvalue = NA_real_, n = 0L
      ))
    }
  
    expr <- expression_data[c(ligand, receptor), , drop = FALSE]
    if (log_transform) expr <- log2(expr + 1)

    expression_df <- as.data.frame(t(expr), check.names = FALSE) |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")
    names(expression_df)[2:3] <- c("Ligand_exp", "Receptor_exp")
    # Create one model predictor per sample by multiplying ligand and receptor expression.
    expression_df$LR_Product <- expression_df$Ligand_exp * expression_df$Receptor_exp
    names(expression_df)[1] <- sample_col

    # Keep only samples with matching clinical data and complete model inputs.
    model_data <- clinical_data |>
      dplyr::inner_join(expression_df, by = sample_col) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(.data[[time_col]]),
        !is.na(.data[[event_col]]),
        !is.na(LR_Product)
      )

    if (!is.null(cell_fraction_name)) {
      model_data <- model_data |>
        dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[cell_fraction_name]])) |>
        dplyr::mutate(cell_fraction = as.numeric(.data[[cell_fraction_name]]))
    }

    if (nrow(model_data) < 3 ||
        dplyr::n_distinct(model_data$LR_Product) < 2 ||
        (!is.null(cell_fraction_name) &&
         dplyr::n_distinct(model_data$cell_fraction) < 2)) {
      return(data.frame(
        Pair = pair_name, Predictor = pair_name, logHR = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_,
        upper = NA_real_, pvalue = NA_real_, n = nrow(model_data)
      ))
    }

    # Add the cell fraction interaction only when a fraction column was requested.
    model_formula <- if (is.null(cell_fraction_name)) {
      survival::Surv(model_data[[time_col]], model_data[[event_col]]) ~ LR_Product
    } else {
      survival::Surv(model_data[[time_col]], model_data[[event_col]]) ~
        LR_Product * cell_fraction
    }

    fit <- survival::coxph(model_formula, data = model_data)
    model_terms <- attr(stats::terms(model_formula), "term.labels")
    coefficient_name <- if (is.null(cell_fraction_name)) {
      model_terms[model_terms == "LR_Product"]
    } else {
      model_terms[grepl(":", model_terms, fixed = TRUE)]
    }
    if (length(coefficient_name) != 1L) {
      stop("Could not uniquely identify the Cox term for the forest plot.")
    }
    # Extract the exact main or interaction term used in the forest plot.
    coefficient <- extract_cox_term(fit, coefficient_name)
    log_hr <- coefficient[1, "coef"]
    se <- coefficient[1, "se(coef)"]
    predictor_name <- if (is.null(cell_fraction_name)) {
      pair_name
    } else {
      paste(pair_name, "x", cell_fraction_name)
    }

    data.frame(
      Pair = pair_name,
      Predictor = predictor_name,
      logHR = log_hr,
      lower = log_hr - 1.96 * se,
      upper = log_hr + 1.96 * se,
      pvalue = coefficient[1, "Pr(>|z|)"],
      n = nrow(model_data)
    )
  }) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows()
    # add FDR correction
    results = results %>%
      dplyr::mutate(FDR = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"))
  # Return both the tabular model results and the matching forest-style plot.
  plot <- plot_cox_results(results, data_name, survival_type)

  list(results = results, plot = plot)
}


```

```{r}
# Run one univariate Cox model for each deconvolution fraction.
run_fraction_survival <- function(
    survival_data,
    time_col,
    event_col,
    fraction_columns = deconv_fraction_columns,
    data_name,
    survival_type,
    scale = T # zscore the fraction columns for better comparability of hazard ratios
) {
  # Fail early if the selected endpoint or fraction predictors are unavailable.
  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    c(time_col, event_col, fraction_columns),
    names(survival_data)
  )
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      "Missing columns for ", data_name, " ", survival_type, ": ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  # Fit each fraction independently so the hazard ratios are directly comparable.
  results <- lapply(fraction_columns, function(fraction_column) {
    # Standardize the endpoint and predictor columns, then remove incomplete samples.
    model_data <- survival_data %>%
      transmute(
        .time = as.numeric(.data[[time_col]]),
        .event = as.numeric(.data[[event_col]]),
        .fraction = as.numeric(.data[[fraction_column]])
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(.time), !is.na(.event), !is.na(.fraction))

    if (nrow(model_data) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(model_data$.fraction) < 2) {
      return(data.frame(
        Dataset = data_name,
        Survival = survival_type,
        Fraction = fraction_column,
        Predictor = fraction_column,
        logHR = NA_real_,
        lower = NA_real_,
        upper = NA_real_,
        pvalue = NA_real_,
        n = nrow(model_data)
      ))
    }
    if(scale){
      model_data$.fraction <- scale(model_data$.fraction)
    }

    # Estimate the fraction's log hazard ratio and derive its 95% confidence interval.
    fit <- survival::coxph(
      survival::Surv(.time, .event) ~ .fraction,
      data = model_data
    )
    # Extract the exact fraction term used in the model and plot.
    coefficient <- extract_cox_term(fit, ".fraction")
    log_hr <- coefficient[1, "coef"]
    se <- coefficient[1, "se(coef)"]

    data.frame(
      Dataset = data_name,
      Survival = survival_type,
      Fraction = fraction_column,
      Predictor = fraction_column,
      logHR = log_hr,
      lower = log_hr - 1.96 * se,
      upper = log_hr + 1.96 * se,
      pvalue = coefficient[1, "Pr(>|z|)"],
      n = nrow(model_data)
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()

  # add FDR correction
  results = results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(FDR = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"))

  # Keep the results and plot together for convenient inspection in the notebook.
  list(
    results = results,
    plot = plot_cox_results(results, data_name, survival_type)
  )
}

```

```{r}
# Plot Cox model log hazard ratios and their 95% confidence intervals.
# Both ligand-receptor and deconvolution models use this same result format.
plot_cox_results <- function(results, data_name, survival_type) {
  # Highlight predictors that remain significant after FDR correction.
  plot_data <- results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      FDR_significance = dplyr::if_else(
        !is.na(FDR) & FDR < 0.05,
        "FDR < 0.05",
        "FDR >= 0.05 or unavailable"
      )
    )
  plot_data$FDR_significance <- factor(
    plot_data$FDR_significance,
    levels = c("FDR < 0.05", "FDR >= 0.05 or unavailable")
  )
  # Create the y-axis factor from the same rows used for x/error-bar values.
  # This keeps each label, estimate, and confidence interval synchronized.
  predictor_levels <- plot_data$Predictor[order(plot_data$logHR, na.last = TRUE)]
  plot_data$Predictor <- factor(
    plot_data$Predictor,
    levels = unique(predictor_levels)
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(
  plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(x = logHR, y = Predictor)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
    orientation = "y",
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(fill = FDR_significance),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    size = 3
  ) +
  # שכבת דמה שמכריחה את המקרא לצייר את שני הסמלים גם כשאין תצפיות מובהקות
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = data.frame(
      logHR = NA_real_,
      Predictor = plot_data$Predictor[1],
      FDR_significance = factor(
        c("FDR < 0.05", "FDR >= 0.05 or unavailable"),
        levels = c("FDR < 0.05", "FDR >= 0.05 or unavailable")
      )
    ),
    ggplot2::aes(fill = FDR_significance),
    shape = 21,
    color = "black",
    size = 3,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    name = "Multiple-testing result",
    values = c(
      "FDR < 0.05" = "darkorange2",
      "FDR >= 0.05 or unavailable" = "white"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = paste(
      data_name,
      survival_type,
      "Hazard Ratios (log scale)\n with 95% Confidence Intervals"
    ),
    subtitle = "Filled points indicate FDR < 0.05",
    x = "log(HR) (95% CI)",
    y = ""
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16)
  )
}
```

# Dou survival analysis

```{r}
#|fig-height: 8
#|fig-width: 15
lr_survival_lrrfs <- run_lr_survival(
  expression_data = dou_exprs,
  clinical_data = dou_deconv_survival,
  sample_col = "Case Number",
  time_col = "LRRFS_time",
  event_col = "LRRFS_event",
  survival_type = "LRRFS",
  data_name = "Dou",
  lr_pairs = lr_pairs,
  cell_fraction_name = "naive_t_cells_fraction"
)

p1 = lr_survival_lrrfs$plot

lr_survival_dmfs <- run_lr_survival(
  expression_data = dou_exprs,
  clinical_data = dou_deconv_survival,
  sample_col = "Case Number",
  time_col = "DMFS_time",
  event_col = "DMFS_event",
  survival_type = "DMFS",
  data_name = "Dou",

)

p2 = lr_survival_dmfs$plot
#|fig-height: 13

p_dou_lr
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# 1. הגדרת הנתונים עבור 3 השלבים
steps_df <- data.frame(
  step_num = c(1, 2, 3),
  x_center = c(2, 6, 10),
  step_label = c("STEP 1", "STEP 2", "STEP 3"),
  title = c(
    "Stromal Recruitment\n(iCAF Gateway)",
    "Luminal Tethering\n(The Unprimed Trap)",
    "Active Suppression\n(Checkpoint Paralysis)"
  ),
  sender = c("iCAFs", "Luminal Cells", "Luminal Cells"),
  mechanism = c(
    "CXCL12 / CXCL14\n↓\nCXCR4",
    "VCAN / Integrins / Laminins\n(No CD80/86 Co-stimulation)",
    "NECTIN2 / NECTIN3\n↓\nTIGIT / CD96"
  ),
  receiver = c("Infiltrating T Cells", "Naive T Cells", "Infiltrating T Cells"),
  outcome = c(
    "Peritumoral stromal entry",
    "Physical retention without priming",
    "T-cell paralysis & immune evasion"
  ),
  accent_color = c("#10B981", "#F59E0B", "#EF4444"),
  bg_fill      = c("#F0FDF4", "#FFFBEB", "#FEF2F2")
)

# 2. הגדרת החצים המחברים בין השלבים
arrows_df <- data.frame(
  x_start = c(3.65, 7.65),
  x_end   = c(4.35, 8.35),
  y       = c(5.0, 5.0)
)

# 3. בניית הגרף
p <- ggplot() +
  # כרטיסיות רקע לכל שלב
  geom_rect(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(
      xmin = x_center - 1.55, xmax = x_center + 1.55,
      ymin = 1.2, ymax = 8.8,
      fill = bg_fill, color = accent_color
    ),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  
  # פס כותרת עליון (Badge) לכל שלב
  geom_rect(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(
      xmin = x_center - 0.7, xmax = x_center + 0.7,
      ymin = 8.45, ymax = 9.15,
      fill = accent_color
    ),
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(x = x_center, y = 8.8, label = step_label),
    color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 6
  ) +
  
  # כותרת השלב
  geom_text(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(x = x_center, y = 7.75, label = title),
    color = "#1E293B", fontface = "bold", size = 5, lineheight = 1.1
  ) +
  
  # קו הפרדה מתחת לכותרת
  geom_segment(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(x = x_center - 1.25, xend = x_center + 1.25, y = 7.05, yend = 7.05, color = accent_color),
    linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # תיבת Sender (התא השולח)
  geom_rect(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(xmin = x_center - 1.2, xmax = x_center + 1.2, ymin = 6.1, ymax = 6.75),
    fill = "white", color = "#CBD5E1", linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(x = x_center, y = 6.42, label = paste0("Sender: ", sender)),
    color = "#334155", fontface = "bold", size = 5
  ) +
  
  # תיבת המנגנון המולקולרי (Ligand-Receptor)
  geom_text(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(x = x_center, y = 4.95, label = mechanism, color = accent_color),
    fontface = "bold", size = 5, lineheight = 1.15
  ) +
  
  # תיבת Receiver (התא הקולט)
  geom_rect(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(xmin = x_center - 1.2, xmax = x_center + 1.2, ymin = 3.15, ymax = 3.8),
    fill = "white", color = "#CBD5E1", linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(x = x_center, y = 3.47, label = paste0("Target: ", receiver)),
    color = "#334155", fontface = "bold", size = 5
  ) +
  
  # קופסת תוצאה פונקציונלית בתחתית
  geom_rect(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(xmin = x_center - 1.35, xmax = x_center + 1.35, ymin = 1.5, ymax = 2.55, fill = accent_color),
    alpha = 0.15, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = steps_df,
    aes(x = x_center, y = 2.02, label = paste0("Outcome:\n", outcome)),
    color = "#0F172A", fontface = "italic", size = 5, lineheight = 1.15
  ) +
  
  # חצים גדולים בין הכרטיסיות
  geom_segment(
    data = arrows_df,
    aes(x = x_start, xend = x_end, y = y, yend = y),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.28, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    color = "#475569", linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_color_identity() +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.2, 11.8), ylim = c(0.8, 9.5)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )

print(p)
```
